claims: Maintain lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volume and monitor plateau pressures and driving pressure.
Wean supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 92-96%, avoiding hyperoxia given PaO2 388 mmHg on FiO2 40%.
Continue temporary pacemaker with rate ~60 bpm and monitor for bradyarrhythmia or pacemaker malfunction.
Monitor arterial blood gases and respiratory rate closely during spontaneous breathing trial or ventilator weaning.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly glucose checks targeting 100-180 mg/dL.
Replete potassium given whole-blood potassium 3.4 mEq/L and continue monitoring serum potassium.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit for anemia (Hgb 10.2-10.4 g/dL) and transfuse if clinically indicated.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium screening (CAM-ICU) with goal RASS 0.
Provide VTE prophylaxis with mechanical and/or pharmacologic measures given immobility and critical illness.
Mobilize patient with physical therapy and maintain head-of-bed elevation to prevent complications.
